description:
We Went Inside explains how everyday things work, by going inside them. Why does your phone battery get worse every year? What happens in the two seconds after you tap your card? Why do traffic jams appear for no reason?

In each episode Wren asks the question you would ask, and Ozzo, a lens that can go inside anything, shows the answer with a picture you can follow. Episodes run about eight minutes, for adults and curious older teens.

Every factual claim is checked against a source, and the sources are linked under each video.

How it is made: the episodes are written, drawn and animated in code with an AI assistant, and both voices are computer-generated. A person watches every episode before it is published.

New episodes about once a week.
